pair.noDimmersFound: No dimmers found nearby. Make sure they have power and that Homey Pro is within Bluetooth range, then try again.

members.title: Dimmers in this group
members.hint: Tick the dimmers this group should drive. They must already be added as dimmers in Homey.
members.none: No dimmers have been added yet. Add your dimmers first, then add a group.

status.title: Status
status.help: A status poll reads the dimmers' levels over Bluetooth. Without it, Homey only shows what the app itself sent — changes made at the wall switch go unnoticed. Polling also makes control slower, so pick a longer interval rather than a shorter one. If the app becomes slow or unreliable, turn it off.

logging.title: Logging
logging.infoHint: Commands and status updates in the app log. Errors are always logged.
logging.debugHint: Full BLE and GATT tracing. Only turn this on while troubleshooting; it produces a lot of log output.

keepAlive.title: Keep the connection open
keepAlive.label: After a command
keepAlive.help: Experimental. Normally the app connects for each command, which takes a few seconds. With this on, it stays connected for a while after a command, so the next ones are fast. While it is connected, the SG phone app may not be able to reach the dimmers, and status polling waits.
